text:
elle.design: Quick a11y question — model results panel moves focus when streaming starts. Keyboard users report jolt.

kevin.eng: That was to highlight output but agree it's disruptive. We focus results container on first chunk.

maya.a11y: Recommend not forcing focus. Use an aria-live polite region for announcements and provide an explicit, focusable 'Jump to results' control.

sam.pm: Will users miss results if we don't move focus? The jump control should be discoverable.

kevin.eng: Proposed pattern: no programmatic focus; display a small keyboard-focusable banner with count and a Jump button. Include short live announcement like '3 new results available.' Debounce streaming announcements ~700ms.

elle.design: Ensure banner contrast in dark mode — current muted text fails. Use text-normal token. Also keep copy short.

maya.a11y: Accessibility checklist: single offscreen aria-live (polite, atomic), debounce live updates, focusable Jump button with aria-label including count, focus-visible ring >=3:1 contrast.

kevin.eng: I'll prototype HTML/CSS/JS and include NVDA/VoiceOver test notes in PR.

elle.design: Nice. Also document shortcut discoverability and add docs for keyboard-only flow.

sam.pm: Test plan: NVDA+Firefox, VoiceOver+Safari, keyboard-only long-stream scenario.

kevin.eng: Draft PR later today, will tag @maya.a11y and @elle.design for review.
